run_pascal_part_clip_of_name: run the pascal_part_clip_of_name script to generate CLIP text embeddings for PASCAL-PART categories
run_pascal_part_clip_of_name_with_prompt: run the pascal_part_clip_of_name script with prompt photo to generate CLIP embeddings for part-of-object descriptions
run_pascal_part_clip_of_name_with_model: run the pascal_part_clip_of_name script with clip_model ViT-B-32 to encode text features using a different CLIP variant
run_pascal_part_clip_of_name_without_par: run the pascal_part_clip_of_name script with use_part false to generate CLIP embeddings for whole-object category names
run_pascal_part_clip_of_name_save_output: run the pascal_part_clip_of_name script with out_path to save CLIP text features as a numpy array
